title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n
$115,000 - $149,500 a year
\n

title: (Senior) Recruiter (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic, fast-paced work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

We are looking for an experienced and driven (Senior) Recruiter (m/f/d) on a fixed term basis to join our Global BusinessTalent Acquisition team, supporting hiring in Germany HQ & Europe for corporate/business roles. In this role, you'll take ownership of end‑to‑end recruitment, partner with senior stakeholders, and help shape hiring strategies across a broad range of business functions.  

This role is based in Munich (hybrid model) and is offered as a 15-month fixed-term contract to cover maternity leave. 

About the Role 

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for business/corporate roles in Germany & Europe, covering multiple functions and seniority levels 
  • Act as a trusted sparring partner to hiring managers and senior stakeholders, shaping hiring strategies and defining effective sourcing and assessment approaches 
  • Proactively source and engage diverse talent pools using creative, data-driven methods across multiple channels 
  • Lead and conduct structured interviews independently, ensuring a consistent, high-quality selection process 
  • Use recruitment KPIs and ATS reporting (e.g., Greenhouse) to drive data-informed hiring decisions 
  • Deliver an excellent candidate experience while actively strengthening and representing the Flix employer brand throughout the hiring journey  
  • Contribute to cross-functional Talent Acquisition projects, focused on improving processes, scalability, and ways of working 

About You 

  • 4+ years of full-cycle in-house recruiting experience, ideally in a fast-paced, international environment 
  • Proven experience hiring business/corporate roles across multiple functions (e.g. finance, HR, marketing, sales, operations etc.) and seniority levels 
  • Strong stakeholder and offer management skills, with the ability to partner with senior leaders and build trusted relationships 
  • Resilient and agile, comfortable navigating ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities without losing focus or quality 
  • Strong active sourcing expertise with the ability to build and maintain sustainable talent pipelines 
  • Confident using data and recruitment metrics to inform decisions and continuously improve outcomes 
  • Fluent in English, German is a strong plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer 

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Senior Payload Integration Engineer - UGV Platforms  (m/f/d)
description:
Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Senior Payload Integration Engineer, you will own the payload integration across our UGV platforms: the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration of a wide range of mission payloads into our own Mandrill UGV and partner vehicle platforms. Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. You will work at the intersection of vehicle hardware, autonomy and MOSAIC orchestration software, mechanical engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing. 


What is your Day to Day Mission:

Payload Integration Architecture and Ownership

  • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions. 

  • Design, specify, and validate payload interfaces: power supply, signal routing, communication interfaces, connectors, mounting concepts, cooling, grounding and shielding, and serviceability. 

  • Enable a payload-flexible vehicle platform that supports a wide range of customer-specific payloads (power profiles, environmental conditions, data interfaces) without major redesigns for every new configuration. 

  • Electrical, Electronic and mechanical Integration

  • Integrate payloads into the vehicle power, network, compute, and control architectures: schematics, harnessing, connectors, fusing, diagnostics, and interface documentation. 

  • Work with vehicle communication buses (CAN, automotive Ethernet) to bring payload data and control interfaces cleanly into the vehicle architecture. 

  • Own the health of the complete E/E system: systematic cross-domain troubleshooting across payload, harness, power, compute, and software. 

  • Drive payload mounting together with internal vehicle teams and external suppliers: brackets, packaging, accessibility, vibration robustness, environmental protection, maintainability, and manufacturability. 

Bring-up, Commissioning and Validation

  • Plan and execute payload bring-up and commissioning on vehicle prototypes and demonstrators: mechanical fitment, electrical integration, software provisioning (flashing, configuration, diagnostics), troubleshooting, and validation up to full system commissioning where the complete E/E system is proven to work. 

  • Define acceptance criteria, build and run system-level test setups, automate recurring integration and regression tests with scripts and test tooling, and support field testing. 

  • Translate integration findings into design improvements for vehicle and payload interfaces, and feed validated test workflows into our CI and test infrastructure together with the HW integration and SW Factory teams. 

  • Work directly with payload suppliers: clarify requirements, review technical documentation, align interface specifications, and drive issue resolution. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Documentation 

  • Create clear interface control documents, integration guides, test reports, lessons learned, and reusable standards for future payload integrations. 

  • Actively support build-ups, rework, payload installation, and vehicle-level commissioning in the workshop during prototype and customer-specific integration phases. 




What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, vehicle systems, or a comparable technical field. 

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field robotics, vehicle, or mechatronic system integration; you have brought complex E/E systems to life on real vehicles or machines. 

  • Strong E/E integration expertise: power distribution, signal interfaces, connectors, wiring harnesses, grounding, shielding, diagnostics, and vehicle-level troubleshooting. 

  • Hands-on experience with vehicle communication buses (CAN, ideally CAN-FD or automotive Ethernet), including reading and debugging bus traffic during integration. 

  • Solid mechanical integration understanding: mounting concepts, packaging, tolerances, vibration, environmental robustness, accessibility, and serviceability. 

  • Practical software skills for integration work: Linux, scripting (e.g. Python or Bash), software provisioning and configuration of embedded devices, and issue tracking tools. You are comfortable automating recurring integration tests. 

  • Experience defining and running validation setups from bench and rig level up to vehicle-level testing, with a quality-first mindset and the discipline to design reliable, repeatable test setups. 

  • Strong integration mindset: systematic in debugging, structured in documentation, and able to turn unclear payload requirements into practical engineering solutions. 

  • Hands-on mentality: comfortable working directly on vehicles, prototypes, harnesses, brackets, and payload installations in the workshop. 

  • Strong communication skills across engineering teams, suppliers, procurement, and program stakeholders. 

  • Fluent in German and English. 

  • High ownership, pragmatic, and thriving in a fast-paced environment. 

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

Zum Ausbau unseres AI- und Automatisierungsbereichs suchen wir dich als AI Automation Engineer – Marketing & Operations Consulting (m/w/d).

Infos unter www.klickpiloten.de.
 
Deine Aufgaben

Du automatisierst, was daraus regelmäßig entstehen muss: die Präsentation, die sich aus Kampagnendaten selbst zusammenbaut, das Reporting, das Dienstagfrüh fertig im Sheet steht. Und du bleibst nicht bei der Zahl stehen, sondern liest aus den Daten, was sie über Kampagnen, Zielgruppen und Budgets sagen, und machst daraus eine Empfehlung, mit der Teams und Kund*innen etwas anfangen können.

Abweichungen fallen auf, bevor eine Kundin sie bemerkt. Aus wiederkehrenden Fehlerbildern machst du Regeln, die dauerhaft mitlaufen.
  • Enablement und Coaching: Du schulst und begleitest die Teams, fortlaufend und nah an der konkreten Arbeit statt im einmaligen Workshop. Du schreibst Playbooks, Anleitungen und Dokumentation, die auch jemand versteht, der nicht dabei war. Und du erkennst, welche Handarbeit sich zu automatisieren lohnt und welche man besser Handarbeit sein lässt.
  • Compliance, Datenschutz und Vertraulichkeit: Du entscheidest mit, welche KI-Anbieter und Modelle wir einsetzen und wo Kundendaten dabei landen dürfen. Auch auf Kundenseite bist du die Person, die mit IT-Abteilungen und Technikpartnern auf Augenhöhe spricht und zwischen Marketing-Anforderung und technischer Umsetzung übersetzt.
  • Innovation: Du beobachtest, was sich bei Modellen, Agenten-Frameworks und Marketing-APIs bewegt, bewertest neue Features nüchtern und entscheidest, was davon bei uns Produktivbetrieb verdient – und was nicht.
Was diese Stelle nicht ist
Damit wir uns gegenseitig keine Zeit nehmen:
  • Keine reine Beratungsrolle. Du berätst Kund*innen, aber du baust jede Woche auch selbst.
  • Kein klassischer Entwicklerjob. Du sitzt nicht im abgeschirmten Sprint, sondern zwischen Fachteams und Kund*innen.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung, Stichwort Vibe Coding – und kannst gleichzeitig beurteilen, was dabei herauskommt: TypeScript oder Python, REST-APIs, OAuth, Git, Datenbanken. Du musst keine Software-Architektin sein, aber ein Stacktrace darf dich nicht abschrecken und generierter Code geht bei dir nicht ungeprüft in Produktion.
  • Praxis mit LLM-APIs: Tool Use, strukturierte Ausgaben, Embeddings, das Bewerten von Ergebnisqualität und ein Gefühl für Token-Kosten.
  • Digitalmarketing-Verständnis. Du weißt, was eine Kampagnenstruktur ist, was ein Sichtbarkeitsindex aussagt und warum Attribution kompliziert ist.
  • Sicherheit in Web Analytics: Du kannst ein sauberes, einwilligungskonformes Tracking-Setup aufbauen, Datenquellen zusammenführen und aus dem Ergebnis eine Empfehlung ableiten – nicht nur ein Dashboard bauen.

  • Du bist gern vor Kund*innen: Du kannst eine technische Lösung so präsentieren, dass auch die Marketingleitung versteht, was sie davon hat, und sagst auch mal ab, wenn eine Idee sich nicht rechnet.
  • Du kannst erklären: verständlich, geduldig, ohne Fachjargon, wo er nicht nötig ist.
  • Du dokumentierst, ohne dass man dich darum bitten muss.
  • Deutsch als Muttersprache und sicheres Englisch für jede Dokumentation.
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Terminen bei Kund*innen und an unseren anderen Standorten.
Ob du das auf Mid- oder Senior-Level machst, klären wir gemeinsam. Uns interessiert, was du gebaut hast, nicht wie lange du dabei bist.

title: Personalreferent (m/w/d) Recruiting und Personalbetreuung | nördlich Braunschweig an der A2
description:
Du brennst für Personalarbeit und entzündest dieses Feuer in anderen.

Bei KITO arbeiten rund 80 Menschen an Sicherheitsarmaturen für den Explosionsschutz. Unsere Produkte kommen unter anderem in Tankanlagen, Rohrleitungssystemen, Biogasanlagen und Wasserstoffanwendungen zum Einsatz und leisten dort einen wichtigen Beitrag: Sie schützen Menschen und Anlagen vor Bränden und Explosionen.

Lösungen entstehen durch Menschen. Deshalb wollen wir auch unsere Personalarbeit weiterentwickeln und einen HR-Bereich aufbauen, der nah an den Mitarbeitenden ist und das Wachstum von KITO unterstützt.

Du willst Personalarbeit nicht nur in bestehenden Strukturen machen, sondern selbst mit aufbauen und gestalten. Recruiting bleibt dabei ein wichtiger Teil deiner Arbeit. Gleichzeitig übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt weitere HR-Themen.

Aufgaben

Recruiting und Personalplanung

  • Du entwickelst die Personalplanung gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung und Führungskräften weiter, erkennst kommende Bedarfe und leitest daraus Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Recruitingwege ab.
  • Du steuerst das operative Recruiting von der Stellenentwicklung über Bewerberkommunikation und Gespräche bis zur Auswahl und zum Onboarding.
  • Du entscheidest, über welche Kanäle und Wege wir die jeweiligen Zielgruppen am besten erreichen, und entwickelst Ansprache und Maßnahmen laufend weiter.

Mitarbeiterbetreuung und Entwicklung

  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeitenden, nimmst ihre Anliegen auf, kümmerst dich eigenständig um die Klärung und hältst die Themen verbindlich nach.
  • Du erkennst, wo Mitarbeitende sich weiterentwickeln wollen oder sollen, stößt passende Weiterbildungen an und schärfst bestehende Instrumente pragmatisch nach.

Beratung und HR-Aufbau

  • Du baust den HR-Bereich bei KITO mit auf, bringst eigene Ideen ein, schaffst tragfähige Strukturen und Standards und treibst einfache, digitale Lösungen für die Personalarbeit voran.
  • In Personalfragen berätst du Geschäftsführung und Führungskräfte, ordnest Situationen ein, zeigst Handlungsoptionen auf und gibst klare Empfehlungen.

Kultur und Zusammenarbeit

  • Du stärkst Wertschätzung und Vertrauen im Arbeitsalltag, förderst einen offenen und konstruktiven Umgang mit Fehlern und machst gute Arbeit sichtbar.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit HR- oder Personalbezug.
  • Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre praktische Recruiting-Erfahrung mit, idealerweise im gewerblichen oder produzierenden Umfeld.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und verbindlich, übernimmst Verantwortung und behältst mehrere Themen parallel im Griff.
  • Im Gespräch bist du klar und auf Augenhöhe, triffst bei unterschiedlichen Menschen den richtigen Ton und bleibst auch in schwierigen Situationen souverän.
  • Pragmatisch, meinungsstark und lösungsorientiert bleibst du auch bei Gegenwind klar und handlungsfähig.
  • Du bist neugierig und lernbereit und gehst neue Wege, digitale Tools und KI offen an.

Benefits

Mehr Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung: Du bekommst den Freiraum, deinen Bereich mitzugestalten, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung nach und nach auszubauen.

Gezielte Entwicklung: Du musst nicht jedes HR-Thema schon können. In neue Aufgaben wächst du mit passenden Weiterbildungen und individueller externer Begleitung hinein.

Gehalt, das zu deiner Erfahrung passt: Du arbeitest 40 Stunden pro Woche und verdienst je nach Erfahrung und Kompetenz 48.000 bis 55.000 Euro brutto im Jahr.

Zeit für Job und Leben: Du hast 30 Tage Urlaub, kannst deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten und nach Absprache auch mobil arbeiten.

Gemeinsam mehr als arbeiten: Wandertag, Sommergrillen, Weihnachtsfeier und kleinere Aktionen übers Jahr schaffen immer wieder Anlässe, auch außerhalb des Arbeitsalltags etwas zusammen zu machen.

title: Werkstudent:in Text & Content (m/w/d)
description:
Bei unseren Kunden laufen KI-Agenten im operativen Tagesgeschäft. Sie prüfen Rechnungen, ordnen Anfragen ein, bereiten Entscheidungen vor. Nicht im Pitch-Deck, sondern produktiv, im deutschen Mittelstand.

Das ist der gute Teil. Aber, wir sind nicht gut darin, darüber zu reden. Unsere Website erzählt zu wenig davon, und die meisten Projekte, die wir abgeschlossen haben, existieren nirgends als Text.

Wir suchen die Person, die das ändert. Nicht mehr Kanäle, nicht mehr Reichweite sondern bessere Worte für gute Arbeit.

Für wen Du schreibst

Geschäftsführer:innen, Bereichsleitungen und Werkleiter mittelständischer Unternehmen: Maschinenbau, Versicherung, Logistik, Handel. Sie haben viel über KI gehört und wenig gesehen, das im Alltag funktioniert. Sie lesen keine englischen Buzzwords und sie haben nur fünf Minuten.

Für diese Leute zu schreiben ist eine eigene Disziplin. Ein Ton daneben, und der Text ist weg. Genau darum geht es in dieser Rolle: den Kopf von jemandem einnehmen, der völlig anders arbeitet als Du, und dann in seinen Worten schreiben statt in unseren.

Aufgaben

Cases schreiben. Der Kern der Rolle. Du sprichst mit den Kolleg:innen, die ein Projekt gebaut haben, teils auch mit dem Kunden, und machst daraus eine Geschichte, die eine Fremde in vier Minuten versteht: Was war das Problem, was haben wir gebaut, was ist seitdem anders. Das Material liegt da. Es ist nur noch niemand hingegangen und hat es aufgeschrieben.

Die Website texten. Unsere Seite wird gerade neu gebaut. Struktur und Technik machen andere. Die Worte machst Du: Startseite, Leistungsseiten, Cases, Karriereseite. Du pflegst sie danach auch selbst im CMS ein, das lernst Du an einem Nachmittag.

Bestehendes überarbeiten. Pitch-Decks, Newsletter, Lead Magnets, LinkedIn-Posts, Vortragsunterlagen. Vieles davon ist inhaltlich richtig und sprachlich zu lang, zu vage oder zu sehr aus unserer Sicht erzählt. Du gehst da durch und machst es besser.

Schreiben, was in unseren Kanälen steht. Newsletter, Webinare, LinkedIn und unsere Inbox sind die Orte, an denen Deine Texte bei echten Menschen ankommen. Du bedienst die Werkzeuge nicht, Du lieferst den Inhalt: das Skript für ein Webinar, den Newsletter-Text, die Antwortvorlagen, mit denen wir auf eingehende Anfragen reagieren. Versand, Takt und Datenpflege in HubSpot und HeyReach liegen woanders - außer du hast Lust es zu lernen.

Dafür bekommst Du Zugriff auf unsere LinkedIn-Inbox und auf Aufzeichnungen echter Kundengespräche. Nicht als Vertriebsaufgabe, sondern als Materialquelle: Dort steht, wie unsere Kunden über ihr Problem sprechen. Genau diese Worte gehören in unsere Texte.

Optional ist die Visualisierung deiner Arbeit in Form von Präsentationen, Canva-Designs oder Webseiten.

Woran wir nach drei Monaten sehen, dass es funktioniert

  • Vier Cases sind live + der Vertrieb schickt sie tatsächlich an Interessenten.
  • Die neuen Website-Texte stehen und klingen nach uns und unserer Arbeit.
  • Jemand aus dem Team schickt Dir seinen Text vorher zum Drüberlesen, weil er danach besser ist.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist immatrikuliert. Welches Fach, ist uns egal.
  • Du schreibst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau. Nicht nur fehlerfrei, sondern gut: Rhythmus, Kürze, der richtige Ton für den jeweiligen Leser.
  • Du kannst Dich beim Schreiben in Deine Zielgruppe hineinversetzen.
  • Du hast schon einmal etwas geschrieben, das andere gelesen haben. Studierendenzeitung, Newsletter, der Instagram-Kanal eines Vereins, ein Blog, den es seit zwei Jahren gibt.
  • Du bist in Berlin oder ziehst gerade her. Wir arbeiten hybrid, mittwochs sehen wir uns.

Was Du nicht brauchst

Kein Marketing- oder Kommunikationsstudium. Keine Agenturerfahrung. Kein Portfolio. Keine Design- oder Programmierkenntnisse, keine SEO-Zertifikate, keine Erfahrung mit KI-Tools. Was ein Sprachmodell kann und wo es Unsinn erzählt, lernst Du hier in der ersten Woche, an echter Arbeit statt in einem Kurs.

Erfahrung mit Mittelstandskunden brauchst Du auch nicht. Neugier auf sie schon.

Du passt zu uns, wenn

  • … Dich ein schlechter Satz körperlich stört und Du ihn umschreibst, statt darüber zu diskutieren.
  • … Du Dich für Themen begeistern kannst, über die auf LinkedIn niemand spricht: Schadenregulierung, Ersatzteillogistik, Angebotskalkulation und wie KI diese verändert.
  • … Du lieber fünf Fragen stellst, bevor Du anfängst, als hinterher zu erklären, wie es gemeint war.
  • … Du einen Text abgibst, wenn er gut ist, und nicht erst, wenn er perfekt ist.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für Dich, wenn

  • … Du Redaktionspläne, Kanalstrategien und Reportings bauen willst. Das ist hier nicht die Arbeit.
  • … Du für die Startup- und Tech-Bubble schreiben willst. Unsere Leser:innen sitzen in Unternehmen, die es seit vierzig Jahren gibt.
  • … Du nur über das schreiben willst, was Du selbst spannend findest.
  • … Du Feedback an Deinem Text als Kritik an Dir liest. Hier wird jeder Text angefasst, auch der vom Gründer.

Benefits

Deine Worte gehen live. Was Du schreibst, steht wenige Tage später auf der Website oder liegt bei einem Kunden auf dem Tisch. Keine Freigabekette, keine Marketingabteilung über Dir.

Nähe zu echten Kunden. Du schreibst nicht über eine Persona. Du hörst den Leuten zu, für die Du schreibst, und benutzt danach ihre Worte statt unserer.

KI-natives Schreiben, bevor es alle können. Du arbeitest mit Claude, ChatGPT und Cursor an echter Arbeit und lernst dabei den Teil, der schwerer ist als Prompten: erkennen, wann ein Text nach Maschine klingt, und ihn zurückholen. Die meisten Deiner Kommiliton:innen lernen das im ersten Job nach dem Studium. Oder auch nicht.

Ein Gegenüber. Du bekommst Feedback an Deinen Texten, wöchentlich und im Detail. Das ist der Grund, warum diese Rolle mehr bringt als ein Werkstudentenjob in einer großen Marketingabteilung.

Der Rahmen. Büro im EDGE Coworking am Hauptbahnhof, mittwochs Team-Tag, den Rest teilst Du Dir ein. In Klausurenphasen reduzieren, in den Semesterferien aufstocken.

Perspektive. Werkstudierende sind für uns keine günstige Zusatzkapazität, sondern die Pipeline für feste Rollen. Wenn es passt, gibt es nach dem Studium eine realistische Perspektive bei uns.

Lucid Labs ist ein AI-first Studio für angewandte KI im deutschen Mittelstand. Wir beraten nicht nur bei der Auswahl von Anwendungsfällen, sondern bauen und betreiben Lösungen, die produktiv in echten Prozessen laufen. Von der Idee bis zum Piloten beim Kunden dauert es bei uns rund eine Woche. Gründer Marek Janetzke hat zuvor Flightright mit aufgebaut und bis zum erfolgreichen Exit begleitet.

Unsere Kultur in einem Satz: Mitdenken statt abarbeiten. Klartext statt Buzzwords. Umsetzen statt Folienschlacht.

Bewerbung

Schritt 1. Lebenslauf, kein Anschreiben. Dazu zwei Dinge:

  1. Ein Text von Dir, den es schon gibt. Egal woher, egal wie alt.
  2. Eine kleine Aufgabe, rund zwanzig Minuten: Geh auf unsere Webseite, such Dir einen Absatz, der Dir nicht gefällt, und schreib ihn so um, dass eine Geschäftsführerin aus dem Maschinenbau ihn in dreißig Sekunden versteht. Begünde kurz.

Die Aufgabe zählt bei uns mehr als der Lebenslauf.

Schritt 2. Gespräch mit dem Team, 30 Minuten.
Schritt 3. Gespräch mit dem Gründer - tiefer und mehr auf deinen Background
Schritt 4. Arbeitsprobe anhand einer echten Aufgabe
Schritt 5. Kennenlernen mit dem Team, gerne auch im Büro

Schritt 4dem Team.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich.

title: Instandhaltungstechniker (m/w/d) Werkstudent:in
description:
Du möchtest nicht irgendeine Anlage warten, sondern eine Technologie betreuen, die es so weltweit kein zweites Mal gibt? ⚡ 

Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsendes GreenTech Startup, das eines der weltweit ersten skalierbaren Straßenkraftwerke entwickelt. Die Technologie nutzt bestehende Straßeninfrastruktur, um aus dem darüberfahrenden Verkehr erneuerbare Energie zu gewinnen, ohne dafür zusätzliche Flächen zu benötigen. 

Als Instandhaltungstechniker in Hamburg übernimmst du die technische Betreuung des dort installierten Straßenkraftwerks. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Anlage zuverlässig läuft, führst Wartungen und Reparaturen durch und gehst technischen Störungen systematisch auf den Grund. 

Dabei übernimmst du nicht einfach bestehende Abläufe. Da es sich um eine völlig neue Technologie handelt, gestaltest du aktiv mit, wie Wartung, Service und Instandhaltung zukünftig aufgebaut werden. Deine Erfahrungen aus dem laufenden Betrieb fließen damit direkt in die weitere Entwicklung der Serviceprozesse ein. 

Deine Benefits

  • Einzigartige Technologie: Betreue das weltweit erste Straßenkraftwerk im laufenden Betrieb und arbeite an einer GreenTech Technologie, die es in dieser Form bisher nirgendwo sonst gibt.  

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Baue gemeinsam mit dem Team Wartungspläne, Serviceprozesse und Instandhaltungsstrukturen auf, anstatt lediglich bestehende Abläufe zu übernehmen.  

  • Flexible Teilzeit: Arbeite 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit einem Studium oder anderen Verpflichtungen verbinden lassen.  

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Übernimm die technische Betreuung der Anlage in Hamburg und erhalte viel Freiraum bei Wartung, Fehleranalyse und Instandhaltung.  

  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Entwickle dich gemeinsam mit der Technologie weiter und übernimm mit wachsender Erfahrung zusätzliche Verantwortung für Betrieb und Service.  

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Erhalte eine attraktive Bezahlung auf Verhandlungsbasis, abgestimmt auf deine Qualifikation und praktische Erfahrung. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Instandhaltungstechniker bist du für den zuverlässigen technischen Betrieb des Straßenkraftwerks in Hamburg mitverantwortlich. 

  • Wartung & Instandhaltung: Inspiziere und warte die Anlage über Mechanik, Hydraulik und Elektrik hinweg und kümmere dich unter anderem um die Pflege des Hydrauliköls.  

  • Störungsbehebung: Analysiere technische Probleme, behebe Fehler und dokumentiere neben der Lösung auch die jeweilige Ursache.  

  • Serviceaufbau: Erstelle und entwickle Wartungspläne, Ersatzteillisten und technische Servicedokumentationen für die Anlage.  

  • Ersatzteilmanagement: Behalte die vor Ort gelagerten Ersatzteile im Blick und stelle deren strukturierte Verwaltung sicher. 

Dein Profil als Instandhaltungstechniker

  • Du bringst einen technischen Hintergrund in Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Energietechnik oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung mit.  

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der mechanischen Wartung und Instandsetzung technischer Anlagen.  

  • Du verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von hydraulischen Systemen und kannst technische Zusammenhänge selbstständig nachvollziehen.  

  • Du bist für 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche verfügbar und bringst die Flexibilität mit, gelegentlich auch früh, spät oder am Wochenende zu arbeiten, wenn für Arbeiten am Terminal entsprechende Zeitfenster zur Verfügung stehen.  

  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, arbeitest selbstständig und behältst auch bei technischen Problemen einen ruhigen Kopf.  

  • Du arbeitest gerne direkt an der Anlage und im Freien und fühlst dich auch in einem aktiven Verkehrs- und Logistikumfeld wohl.  

  • Das sichere Lesen von technischen Zeichnungen, Hydraulikschaltplänen und Elektroschaltplänen ist von Vorteil. 

Du möchtest eine weltweit einzigartige GreenTech Anlage nicht nur warten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten, wie ihr zukünftiger Betrieb und Service aufgebaut werden? ⚡ 

Dann sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und erfahre in einem kurzen 10-minütigen Kennenlerngespräch mehr über das Unternehmen, die Technologie und deine zukünftige Rolle.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper — Lab54

Location: London. All 3 days in office for the first three months. From month 4, 1 day per week remote once the agreed targets are being met.

Shape: Part-time, 3 days per week. Permanent or contract — both considered.

Salary: £30–34k FTE equivalent, pro-rata (£18–20.5k at 3 days). Contract equivalent £150–200 per day.

Reports to: Financial Controller (interim: Managing Director)

Start: As soon as available

About Lab54

Lab54 is a content-led events and production company: [Anywhere But A Club.]

We create high-impact experiences in unexpected locations, capture them, and turn them into content. Combined global audience of 425,000+. We work with brands, record labels and artists — around 100 events a year across brand activations, artist pop-ups, hard-ticket shows, house parties and festival takeovers.

The role

The Bookkeeper is Lab54's day-to-day finance function: reconciliation, purchase-order matching, receipt capture, invoicing, debtor chasing and payroll preparation.

The defining feature of the job is that every pound has to land against an event. Lab54's core financial object isn't the month — it's the project. Each event carries a code (YYMM-Owner-Event-City) that runs from HubSpot through Xero, Teamwork and the purchase-order flow. Coding transactions to that project is not admin; it's the thing that makes per-event profitability computable. It is the single most important part of this role.

This role prepares, never approves. All payment runs are approved by the Managing Director, with the CEO approving above an agreed threshold.

Responsibilities

Purchase orders and supplier ledger

  • Match supplier invoices to their purchase order in Xero. This is a manual link, and it is the control that stops us paying more than we agreed.
  • Enforce the PO rule at the front door: any commitment of £500 or more needs a PO, and an invoice arriving without a PO number goes back to the supplier rather than into the ledger.
  • Prepare payment runs for approval. Nothing leaves the business without a bill, a PO and a sign-off.
  • Reconcile supplier statements monthly against our purchase ledger — the check that catches duplicate invoices and payments before they're made.
  • Maintain the purchase ledger and keep the aged creditor position accurate.

Reconciliation and coding

  • Bank and card reconciliations kept current within 48 hours, including Revolut Business card spend against Xero tracking categories.
  • Every reconciled line matched to a real source document. A line that reconciles without a bill behind it is an exception to raise, not a box to tick.
  • Code every transaction to the correct project code and tracking category. Chase the team when a code is missing rather than guessing one.
  • Keep the suspense and uncoded accounts at nil by month-end.
  • Produce a weekly untagged-spend report, by spender, and drive it to zero.

Receipts and VAT recovery

  • Chase and capture missing receipts to a 98% target. This is a cash exercise, not a filing one — every missing VAT invoice is input VAT we can't reclaim.
  • Flag transactions carrying no VAT treatment where the supplier is UK VAT-registered.
  • Prepare the VAT return workings for the external accountancy firm, who own submission.

Sales invoicing and debtors

  • Raise client invoices within 48 hours of the billing trigger, coded to the project.
  • Own debtor chasing end to end — a consistent cycle, escalated when it stalls, so nobody else in the business is carrying it.
  • Match incoming receipts to the right invoice and contact. Money that arrives against the wrong customer looks identical to money that never arrived.
  • Keep sales invoice sequencing clean — anything voided or reissued carries a recorded reason.

Project close

  • When a project closes, produce its final position: budgeted cost against actual cost, budgeted revenue against invoiced revenue, and the resulting margin.
  • Issue that to the CEO and Operations Director as a matter of routine. It is not a report anyone should have to request.
  • Late costs land after an event has finished — that's the nature of the business. The job is to make sure they land against the right project and that the closing number reflects them.

Cash and reporting

  • Produce a weekly cash one-pager: bank position, overdue debtors with days outstanding, payment runs due, projected balance.
  • Keep the company's master P&L model current — updating actuals and committed costs as they change, so the forecast reflects where the business genuinely is.
  • The model is ours; you update the numbers within it. Structural or formula changes come to the CEO first.

Payroll preparation

  • Prepare payroll data and submit it to the external payroll provider ahead of deadline.
  • Post the payroll journal to Xero each month. Wages must not sit in a control account.
  • Confirm the payroll account is funded before each run. This role does not execute payroll.

Close, deadlines and records

  • Run the monthly close to a published working-day deadline: accruals prepared with supporting detail, journals posted, period locked.
  • Every accrual carries a schedule — supplier, event, date of work. No balance we can't explain.
  • Maintain the statutory deadline register (VAT, PAYE, corporation tax, Companies House) and flag each one in advance. No filing sits invisibly in someone else's workflow.
  • Keep records orderly and audit-ready for the external accountancy firm.

What the first 90 days actually look like

We are being straight about this because we want someone who finds it interesting rather than alarming.

Lab54 has grown faster than its finance function, and we've recently changed accountants. The ledger carries a real backlog: untagged transactions across two financial years, unposted payroll journals, a month-end close that has not been run to a cadence, and a purchase-order process that has only just gone live. Days 61–90. Run a full month close to deadline: suspense at nil, every accrual scheduled, supplier statements reconciled. Per-project cost data becomes reportable for the first time.

After that it becomes a genuinely well-defined job inside a documented control structure — and you'll have built it.

Who are we?

The Team

Security sits within Infrastructure and Engineering, protecting the distributed, real-time systems behind our trading engine. The team's remit spans our core products and our DCM/DCO entities, with a real regulatory dimension to the work, particularly around our CFTC-regulated business units. Alongside that regulatory scope, the focus is squarely on hands-on engineering: designing, building, and shipping the security tooling and controls that let engineering teams move fast safely.

About the Role:

This is a founding build. You'll stand up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and mature it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams to build the controls, automation, and guardrails our trading systems and regulated entities need.

What you will do:

  • Build the Foundations: Be part of a founding build, standing up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and maturing it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams.

  • Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products.

  • Monitor & Respond: Monitor and analyse system access logs, flag anomalies, and support incident response, containment, and post-incident root cause analysis.

  • Plan for Resilience: Plan and test security backups and disaster recovery processes to keep the platform resilient.

  • Maintain Compliance: Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and controls meeting DCM/DCO requirements, and maintain evidence and documentation to support regulatory examinations and audits.

  • Partner Across Teams: Partner with business and engineering teams on solutions, translating technical work for product and engineering audiences.

Role Requirements:

  • Security Engineering Background: Hands-on experience building security engineering/DevSecOps capabilities in a cloud-native, high-growth environment, ideally financial services or exchange infrastructure.

Smarkets runs one of the world's most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. If you're ready to help shape the future of prediction markets with cutting-edge technology and a customer-first philosophy, Smarkets is where you belong.

This role sits at the heart of our commercial strategy, overseeing marketing teams and working shoulder-to-shoulder with product, trading, data, and the executive team to grow the business. Prediction markets and exchange products are having a moment, and the team's job is to capture that energy: building the Smarkets brand and the brands within our group, and making every pound of the marketing budget work harder than the last.

About the Role:

As our VP Commercial & Marketing, you'll be responsible for every marketing lever we have: brand, acquisition, and retention, across multiple markets, including UK and US. Your team will be accountable for how the world discovers Smarkets and the brands within our group, why they choose us over anyone else, and why they stay.

We're looking for a senior leader who has scaled a direct-to-consumer brand before and understands the pitfalls and opportunities. We need someone who will set the strategy for marketing and roll up their sleeves to execute. If you want to direct from a distance, this isn't the role for you. If you want to own the number, build up the team, and be measured on the growth you deliver, read on.

You will own the marketing budget, and we'll expect you to make every pound work harder than the last. Success looks like ROI and disciplined scaling; failure looks like vanity spend that fails to deliver the unit economics. This role reports to the COO and sits at the heart of our commercial strategy.

What you will do:

  • Own the Strategy: Own a multi-jurisdiction marketing strategy end-to-end, accountable for design and execution across brand, acquisition, and retention.

  • Shape Go-to-Market: Help develop the commercial strategy for go-to-market projects and our core brands.

  • Deliver ROI: Accountable for effective ROI on the annual marketing budget.

  • Build the Team: Mentor and develop a high-performing marketing team, raising the bar on talent and standards.

  • Scale Performance Marketing: Build the processes to scale performance marketing across paid channels, relentlessly improving CAC, ROAS, and payback.

  • Sharpen the Brand: Sharpen and grow the Smarkets brand: our positioning, our voice, and how we show up in a crowded market.

  • Drive Retention: Develop the retention and lifecycle strategy, turning first-time users into loyal, high-value traders through CRM and lifecycle marketing.

  • Own the Metrics: Define the metrics that matter, hold the team to them, and make decisions grounded in data.

  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with product, trading, data, and commercial teams to align marketing with the wider business roadmap.

  • Proven Brand Builder: A senior marketing leader with a proven track record of scaling a brand.

  • D2C Experience: Real experience growing a D2C/consumer business where you owned the relationship with the customer directly.

  • Multiple markets: Has successfully executed a marketing strategy for multiple geographic or cultural regions.

  • Efficient Growth: A demonstrable record of growing a business through efficient acquisition; we want to see strong ROI, not just big spend.

description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth.

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

 

This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business.

 

To know more about our engineering teams:

  • A video of our VP Platform: https://youtu.be/zvTlw4BNNdc

  • Our company purpose: http://bit.ly/3OsScpl

  • Our engineering blog: https://bit.ly/3ASJNID

How we work with the existing teams 💚

 

The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes. The functional managers and senior experts retain ownership of day-to-day execution, technical practices, operational processes, and delivery within their domains. The Director creates the conditions for those leaders to succeed and makes sure their work adds up to a coherent company-wide strategy.

Your next missions 👇

 

Set the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities

  • Define and evolve a multi-year Cybersecurity & IT strategy aligned with Back Market's business goals, risk appetite, technology strategy, and growth plans

  • Translate that strategy into a focused portfolio of initiatives, with clear outcomes, sequencing, ownership, dependencies, and measures of success

  • Own the operating rhythm for the full scope: planning, budgeting, program tracking, KPI and SLA reporting, risk reviews, and executive communication

  • Make pragmatic investment and prioritization recommendations, balancing resilience, customer trust, regulatory expectations, employee experience, and engineering velocity

  • Establish the governance forums and decision mechanisms needed to keep priorities clear and accountability visible

 

Lead and grow a high-performing leadership organization

  • Lead through the managers and senior individual contributors responsible for Security Operations, Governance Risk & Compliance, IT Operations Engineering, IT Support, and relevant security engineering or product security capabilities

  • Coach, challenge, and develop your leaders, helping them grow their scope, judgment, influence, and ability to build strong teams of their own

  • Create clear career paths, succession plans, and development opportunities across the organization

  • Build a high-trust environment where teams have genuine ownership, collaborate across boundaries, and are encouraged to improve how work gets done

  • Attract and retain exceptional talent, define what great leadership and execution look like, and continuously raise the bar without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Ensure that responsibilities, decision rights, and interfaces between the teams are explicit, understood, and respected

 

Turn cybersecurity into a business enabler

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of Engineering, CTO, Executive Committee, and senior leaders across the business

  • Explain complex security, IT, and risk topics in clear business language, including the trade-offs, options, costs, and consequences of different decisions

  • Engage with Heads of and cross-functional streams across Back Market to advocate for security and resilience in all areas of the business

  • Build alignment rather than relying on authority, and help teams adopt secure and resilient ways of working because they understand the rationale and value

  • Partner with Finance and senior technology leadership on investment cases, budget stewardship, vendor strategy, and the value delivered by the portfolio

 

Steer enterprise cyber risk and trust

  • Own the cyber risk management process at the strategic level, using the GRC framework as the foundation for security decisions and prioritization

  • Ensure that material risks, control gaps, exceptions, and remediation plans are visible, understood, and actively managed

  • Escalate critical risks when they exceed the organization's risk appetite or require executive arbitration

  • Support security compliance efforts across the organization, ensuring alignment and buy-in from peers and key stakeholders across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, and contractual partner requirements

  • Partner with the VP Legal and DPO on the company's data privacy strategy, ensuring privacy and security requirements are considered early in business, product, and technology decisions

  • Represent Back Market's security maturity and risk posture to investors, auditors, regulators, strategic partners, and major customers

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for major or complex security incidents, ensuring the right executive communication, decision-making, learning, and follow-through without displacing the operational ownership of the incident response teams

 

Enable secure products and resilient technology

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and other Bureau of Technology directors to ensure security requirements are integrated into product and feature development from the beginning

  • Sponsor and evolve Product Security and secure software development lifecycle practices, including security-by-design, threat modeling, appropriate testing, and pragmatic guardrails

  • Ensure the security roadmap addresses the most important risks across cloud infrastructure, corporate systems, identity and access, endpoints, applications, data, and third-party services

  • Set the expectations for Security Operations across threat intelligence, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident readiness, risk assessment and project design reviews, fraud support, AI security, and associated SLA and KPI tracking

  • Ensure IT Operations and IT Support provide a reliable, scalable, and high-quality experience for Back Makers across our global offices and remote workforce

  • Champion automation, standardization, and engineering-led approaches that reduce manual work and improve reliability, while leaving day-to-day technical ownership with the appropriate functional teams

 

Build security culture and external credibility

  • Foster a security-aware culture through clear communication about the evolving threat landscape, key initiatives, practical expectations, and the role every Back Maker plays in protecting the company

  • Sponsor awareness, education, and Security Champion programs that make secure behavior accessible and relevant to different audiences

  • Represent Back Market in relevant security communities, industry groups, partner forums, and regulatory conversations

  • Build trusted relationships with strategic technology partners, auditors, insurers, and external security providers

  • Help Back Market demonstrate that strong security, responsible technology, and business agility reinforce one another


You could be a good fit if you've:

  • A proven track record of building, scaling, and developing organizations that span multiple security and/or IT domains

  • 12 to 15+ years of experience across cybersecurity, information security, IT, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years leading managers and multi-team organizations

  • Experience operating as a strategic partner to a CTO, VP Engineering, executive committee, or equivalent senior leadership group

  • Proven expertise and a solid grasp of the domains listed below: security operations, cyber risk and governance, compliance and assurance, security architecture, product security, cloud security, IT operations, or corporate technology

  • Demonstrated ability to turn business strategy and risk appetite into a practical security and IT roadmap, investment plan, and operating model

  • Experience communicating security and technology risk to executive, board-level, investor, partner, audit, and non-technical audiences

  • A mature, risk-based approach. You understand that perfect security does not exist, and that good leadership means making explicit, informed trade-offs and focusing resources where they have the greatest impact

  • Experience leading through managers and senior experts, with a genuine passion for developing people, building leadership capability, and creating meaningful career paths

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, application, data, and infrastructure security concepts, even if you are not the deepest technical expert in every domain

  • Experience with security-by-design, secure software development lifecycle practices, and effective partnership with Engineering and Product teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to make complex topics clear, concrete, and compelling. French is a plus

  • The judgment, calm, and influence required to operate effectively in ambiguity, during incidents, and across competing stakeholder priorities

  • Genuine excitement about Back Market's mission and the belief that cybersecurity and IT are essential enablers of sustainable growth

    Nice to have

  • Experience with ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, or other relevant European regulatory and assurance frameworks

  • Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, modern cloud-native security tooling, or SaaS-first environments

description:

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both French and English

  • Commercially rigorous — accurate pipeline management, disciplined forecasting

About the Role

You will work directly with Gavin Wood, Parity's Founder. Your job is to take his vision, goals and ideas, and turn them into clear decisions, aligned teams, and forward momentum. You will think 12 to 24 months ahead, not just manage what is on fire today. You understand that the decisions made now impact the future, and you treat them accordingly.

You will be a key partner to Directors across the business, our CEO, and the primary bridge between Gavin's priorities and the Acceleration team's execution.

What You'll Do

  • Operate as Founder's technical right hand. You will manage his context, his priorities, and his follow-through. You are available when it matters. You anticipate what he needs before he asks for it.

  • Turn chaos into clarity. Parity moves fast. You will work in an environment of competing half-thoughts, ambiguous mandates, and shifting priorities. Your job is to impose structure without killing momentum, and to spot the counterproductive plays before they cause damage.

  • Think long. You will not just solve today's problem. You will map the second- and third-order consequences of decisions being made now and make sure the right people are thinking about them.

  • Lead cross-functional problem solving. When something falls between departments, you pick it up. You have the technical credibility to engage with engineering leadership and the operational instinct to get things moving.

  • Own the leadership rhythm. OKRs, technical reviews, decision-making cadences, you design and run the operating system for Gavin's leadership team.

  • Manage up, across, and down. You will work with C-Level and Directors across different Functions of the business. Each is different. You will adapt your communication style to each of them without losing your own voice.

Your Skills

  • Technically credible. You have a background in engineering or engineering management. You can hold your own with a CTO, challenge timelines credibly, and evaluate the viability of new technical initiatives. You do not need to be a Blockchain Engineer, but you understand the ecosystem well enough to distinguish substance from hype.

  • A sophisticated operator. You have run complex, cross-functional programmes at a senior level, ideally having led a team or founded a company. You know how to create clarity from ambiguity, manage without authority, and drive decisions in organisations that do not move in straight lines. Experience managing leaders, including more junior managers, is a strong signal.

  • Exceptional communicator. Not just clear, adaptive. You can shift registers between a demanding Founder, Functions Leads, and a junior team member. You know what each person needs to hear and how they need to hear it.

  • A long-term thinker. You are not a damage limitation operator. You think about what the decisions being made today mean in 12 to 24 months. You bring that perspective into rooms where others are only looking at this quarter.

  • Believes in Web3. You do not need deep protocol experience. But you need to understand why this technology matters and be genuinely curious about where it is going. Candidates who are indifferent to the mission do not last here.

  • Thrives in ambiguity. Parity is not a machine. It is a high-conviction, fast-moving organisation with a demanding founder. You find that energising, not exhausting.

  • Academically strong. A high-calibre degree matters. If you have one, lead with it. If you don't, your track record needs to be exceptional.

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining teammates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your teammates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

description:

We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

 

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

  • Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

  • Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

  • Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

  • Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

  • Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

  • Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

  • Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

  • Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

  • Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

  • Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

  • Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

  • Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and identify root causes.

  • Audit datasets for linguistic accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

     

Commitment

Roughly 40 hours per week with flexibility in scheduling. Project hours may vary depending on active studies, data projects, and product needs. Participation in periodic coordination meetings during US Pacific hours is expected.

 

Requirements

  • Native-level proficiency in French as spoken in France.

  • Experience with data annotation, transcription, or language quality assurance.

  • Strong foundation in linguistics or a related field, with the ability to apply concepts like phonetics, prosody, and intonation when evaluating speech and writing annotation guidelines.

  • Strong written English proficiency. All guidelines, feedback, reports, and team communication are in English.

  • Ability to write clear, structured instructions and deliver specific, actionable feedback to annotators.

  • Comfortable working with data and metrics such as inter-rater agreement scores, audit spreadsheets, and structured feedback templates.

  • Self-directed and able to manage feedback cycles, QA reviews, and data projects without close oversight.

Preferred

  • Experience writing or maintaining annotation guidelines or rubrics.

  • Experience training, mentoring, or managing other annotators.

  • Experience with audio evaluation, TTS, or STT.

  • Conversational spoken English proficiency for meetings and calibration syncs.

  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.


This is a 1099 contract opportunity and will not be eligible for the benefits below. Language Leads work on an ongoing basis, renewable by mutual agreement.
